review: M05 accepted-main UI compatibility and workspace repair

sourceContext.limitation: The recorder hashes git diff HEAD for tracked changes and excludes the new untracked workspace-components-fixture.tsx. All seven final files, including that fixture and its source inventory registration, are independently bound below. Browser and typecheck captures precede the data-only inventory edit. Source-closure capture binds the later tracked diff. These working-cut checks are not complete immutable published-tree proof; final exact-tree Windows CI remains pending.

changes.change: Serve canonical split layout, profiles and commands using the existing production split reducer, seeded with the exact initial local thread/project owner. This replaces missing API responses, not application behavior.

Remove a contradictory empty split-layout override; use actual current workspace navigation and status roles; copy only x/y/zoom in the viewport response; await committed native-dock state; distinguish catalog reads from owner-scoped composer reads; keep old-owner actions unavailable until the new context resolves.

Replace a literal unexpanded fixtureRoot/generated-file URL with a durable fixture using actual WorkspaceCanvas, WorkspaceControls, DesktopProvider, ProjectContextCard and PlanStatus components. Align profile recovery and plan region selectors with current controls. Synthetic host callbacks retain explicit draft failure and native readiness failure followed by host rollback.

The retired native main-window pin test is replaced by the current canvas panel alwaysOnTop action. It checks the exact source-panel mutation, visible data-pinned state and absence of native/stop commands. This does not newly prove native window pinning.

An embedded conversation with hostWorkspaceContext no longer renders its own workspace tool panel or has-right-panel shell state. Its tool action forwards to the host with captured view.binding. Ordinary current-main actions retain the shared right panel; custom, different-owner or remote bindings go through existing openSplitTool with explicit owner binding, including its foreign-authority rejection.

Separate reviewed native Save diagnostic repair replaces RootElement.Children discovery with bounded exact-owned-PID EnumWindows and AutomationElement.FromHandle. All subsequent owner, title, unique-control, destination lease, completion/readback and cleanup checks remain. The local seven-case test is unit custody evidence only.

Root added exactly the new durable component fixture to the declared exported source list. Runtime inventory and all source-closure assertions remain unchanged; existing public-source tests pass eleven cases.

preservedAssertions: Exact Workspace panel role query remains strict and detects duplicate asides; no first/nth selector workaround.
Primary close, ordinary reopen, reload, anchored draft, no detached canvas panels and no run.stop remain.
The real embedded composer Inspect changes action now must select the shared Diff tab and preserve its draft.
Independent main/side drafts, child read-only transcript, current native identity, owner retarget refusal, no unauthorized rebase and fixed tool binding remain.
Read cancellation still requires the obsolete request to abort while each live owner request remains active.
Profile rollback, refused draft flush, no-stop hiding, keyboard zoom/snapped geometry, mounted artifact edits, reduced motion and composer focus remain.

captureMetadataContract: Each checksum-bound metadata file contains the exact invoked argv, actual executable identity, capture timestamps, elapsed duration, child exit/termination, raw and bounded output digests, source/diff fields and recorder identity. Older captured phase labels are preserved and separately classified above. No failed command is discarded or relabeled PASS.
reporterLocations: Reporter line numbers differ from the compact source line numbers. The tested file bytes and exact test titles are the review anchors; no unmeasured source-map explanation or line-number identity is asserted.
